name: Chibi Test
description: A hand-authored test rig for the style geometry: the large-head, small-body layout from the Ragnarok-like style profile. Generate its layers in the Designer with the same style, or use it as a reference for a chibi rig.

parts.brief: short chibi legs in a small pair of boots; the feet sit flat at the bottom of the frame
a small chibi torso with a short belted tunic; bright cloth, thick outline
a short chibi sleeve and a small mitten-like hand
a short chibi sleeve and a small mitten-like hand; this hand holds weapons
a large chibi head with large expressive eyes and a small nose; bright skin, thick dark outline
chibi hair with a large fringe over the forehead; bright saturated colour, thick outline
